The harness straps connecting the tank to the BCD are faint and lack clear structural definition, appearing to merge slightly with the background water and suit.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image strictly adheres to the 'scuba diver' class and distinguishes it from similar classes like 'snorkeler' or 'underwater swimmer'.
To assess the overall coherence of the underwater lighting, particulate matter, and to detect any subtle generation artifacts in the murky background.
